Shri Vishwamitra, hearing the piteous words of Shunashepha

Hearing these words, Madhusyanda and the other sons

brief.summary_1line: Shunashepha seeks refuge with Vishwamitra to escape being sacrificed, leading the sage to curse his disobedient sons and teach the boy mantras for salvation.

image_candidates.scene_text: Exhausted Shunashepha falls at Vishwamitra’s feet among meditating sages at Pushkara, pleading for protection.
Vishwamitra, eyes blazing with anger, raises his hand to curse his sons who stand defiantly before him.
The young boy, garlanded in red and smeared with sandalwood, stands bound to the sacrificial post while Vishwamitra secretly teaches him sacred mantras.
